blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Condos and townhomes are one line in the reports.

blocks.text: Before you buy 55+ homes in Coquitlam
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: Is Coquitlam a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Coquitlam had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many 55+ homes are for sale in Coquitlam?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the 55+ homes in Coquitlam that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when 55+ homes come up in Coquitlam?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Coquitlam homes?
faq.a: The Coquitlam homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Coquitlam market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: The monthly SnapStats reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so the monthly counts here include both. The boards’ benchmark prices are published separately for apartments and townhomes.
